text: A股军工板块震荡拉升，博云新材午后涨停，内蒙一机此前封板，天秦装备、北方长龙、建设工业、长城军工涨超5%。
text_en: A-share military sector fluctuated upward, with Boyun New Material hitting the daily limit in the afternoon, Inner Mongolia First Machinery having previously sealed the limit, and Tianqin Equipment, North Long Dragon, Construction Industry, and Great Wall Military Industry rising more than 5%.
